title: NASA Releases MAX POWER Key Events for Media, Participants
text: America’s newest aerospace expo and air show – MAX POWER – is fast approaching, and NASA has announced key events beginning Friday, Nov. 6, and running through Sunday, Nov. 8, hosted on and near the agency’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida. zhTitle: NASA 公布 MAX POWER 重要活動資訊，供媒體與參與者使用
